description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the JobCategoryDao component in the Admin module of the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup routines and test methods to verify the behavior of the data access object responsible for job category data management.

classes.name: JobCategoryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the JobCategoryDao functions related to job category data retrieval in the Admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup method that initializes the DAO object, sets the fixture path, and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests whether the list retrieval method returns the expected number of job categories.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests whether retrieving a job category by ID returns the correct name.
